description: Stablecoins ranked by circulating supply in USD, updated daily: per stablecoin its peg type and mechanism, price, supply now and a day, a week and a month ago (in peg units), the 1d/7d/30d change and its largest chains, with the total over the selection, 50 per page. With chain, the supply, ranking and total are that chain's (stablecoin_chains ranks the chains). Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain.description: A chain name as DefiLlama writes it, case-insensitive (Ethereum, Tron, Base, BSC, Solana).

peg_type.description: A peg, case-insensitive (peggedUSD, peggedEUR, peggedVAR for floating).
